name: Sol
source:
Friend of Ren and Cecilia, and a star player of the school basketball team. He has a very robust build, but is seemingly not too much of a ladies’ man. 
He's always confused about the subtle relationship between Ren and Cecilia. Half of it is out of worry, and the remainder is frustration.
